description:
The AWS Serverless Application Model (SAM) is an open-source framework for building serverless applications.


- feat(build): Add sam build support for MicrovmImage (#9357)
- fix: preserve backslashes in Fn::Sub replacement values (#9397)
- fix(local): report a taken host port instead of a raw APIError (#9294)
- feat(build): Support X86_64 MicrovmImages (#9415)
- feat(package): Add sam package support for MicrovmImage (#9399)
- fix: route durable function container traffic over a dedicated network (#9400)
- fix(intrinsics): compare Fn::Equals values as strings (#9407)
- fix(local-apigw): treat authorizer resource ARNs as literals, not regex (#9155)
